description: Whether Ontario Regulation 213/91 requires a support system for an excavation, by depth, width and soil type, which kinds are permitted, and which other excavation rules apply. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Preliminary planning only. Regulations are amended from time to time; confirm against the current consolidation. The engineer of record and the competent person on site govern.

adjacent.description: Whether the excavation could affect an adjacent building or structure.

depth.description: Excavation depth. Unit: m or ft.

engineer_opinion.description: Whether there is a written engineer opinion that an unsupported wall is stable (section 234(2)(h), non-trench excavations only).

enter.description: Whether a worker will be required to enter the excavation.

hydrostatic.description: Whether hydrostatic pressure or groundwater is present in the soil.

soil.description: Soil type 1 to 4 under section 226. If more than one type is present, use the highest number.

wall.description: How the walls are formed: vertical or near vertical, sloped back at the gradient in section 234(2) for the soil type, or cut in sound and stable rock.

width.description: Excavation width at the bottom. Unit: m or ft.

name: trench_shoring_checker
title: Trench Shoring Requirement Checker
